page.title: Styles
page.purpose: Capture a house sound once as data and reuse it. A style compiles to a caption plus parameters, and is the unit a batch and a maintained inventory are configured with.

priorities.statement: The compiled result is visible while editing. A style is only meaningful through what it compiles to, so the caption and parameters the generator will receive are shown, not hidden behind the abstraction.
Built-in styles are clearly distinguished from custom ones and cannot be edited in place; they are duplicated instead.
A style is portable data. Import and export are first-class, so a house sound survives this scenario.
Parameters that decide the result are given the weight they deserve. Tempo, key, and the instruction that the authored caption passes through unmodified are not advanced settings.
